meta.title: Adding vendors to a closed stage is refused with 95

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The buyer withdraws the event first (with a remark).
The buyer sends the request that invites vendors to a round, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Trade Request not found”, and never with a server error.
